title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode2 Kohane's Task

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to become strong enough to blast a hole in the moment RAD WEEKEND became a legend...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The moment when...
He's talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Let me get one thing clear first.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you're all able to accomplish the tasks I give you and achieve your true potential, then you should have no problem putting on an event just as good as RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: No... Not should. I know that you will.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
“Just as good” isn't good enough.
Your goal is to surpass it, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
“This is just like RAD WEEKEND.”
“It's that night all over again.”

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: For better or worse, as long as you're trying to surpass that night, you won't be able to avoid being compared with it. That just comes with the territory.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which brings me to your task.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll need to find a way to break open the door that takes you all from being “just as good” to actually surpassing it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The door...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've all experienced it a number of times already.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: When things really matter, she absolutely explodes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...has this way of finding gears that we didn't imagine she had.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she does.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Azusawa sometimes enters a state where she channels all of her energy into her singing. When she does, she's explosive.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Exactly. That's what you need to bet on.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She only has to reach that peak for a second. Actually, a second might be all you can manage.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
She has to create that moment.
A moment that drives the audience far wilder than we did that night.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Blast a hole in that moment. Then, they'll all know for sure.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: They'll say, “This event isn't just an echo of RAD WEEKEND.”

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: They'll see it as a new legend unfolding before their eyes.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: After that, the rest of you will have to propel yourselves forward using absolutely everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Her task is just to get the door moving.
Whether or not you're able to push it wide open will depend on your collective resolve.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But knowing all of you...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll succeed. I firmly believe that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, if I can do that for even a second...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can get the door open just a crack, then we'll get our chance. We might actually be able to go beyond Nagi and her team's dream.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That moment...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No...
I shouldn't be thinking about whether or not I can.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I just have to do this.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to succeed no matter what!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Obviously, accomplishing this task is going to be the furthest thing from easy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why you need to become stronger. It'll all be for naught if you achieve that moment but don't have the strength to actually succeed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The strength to actually succeed...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That's right.
Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll be receiving some special coaching.
